title: The Science of Color by Captain Disillusion
content: This new YouTube video by "Captain Disillusion" (Link to YouTube) explains a lot of important points about color: how we perceive it and how we chart it, from the hue circle of Isaac Newton to modern 3D luminance diagrams.Every second of the video is packed with information, all beautifully illustrated with motion graphics.  It goes by so fast you almost have to watch it twice to get it all.For painters, a key quote is "A limited palette works just fine as long as the color relationships remain the same."In the comments, can someone please share the links to the free software he mentioned that lets you chart 3D color gamuts and luminance charts?
